question: Sultan Mahmud came to India from which of the following city of Afghanistan?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Ghazni**__. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Sultan Mahmud came to India from **Ghazni**.
 
• The very first ruler in history to assume the title of "Sultan" was Mahmud of Ghazni, founder of the **Ghaznavid Empire.**
 
• **Mahmud of Ghazni** was a Turkish conqueror who attacked India **17 times between 1000 to 1027 AD.**
 
• The biggest invasion of Mahmud of Ghazni was in 1025 AD wherein he invaded the** Somnath temple in Gujarat.**
 
• In all his **17 invasions, **a number of dynasties were conquered by him.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Al-Biruni **was an Iranian scholar and polymath.
 
• He was from Khwarezm — a region that encompasses modern-day western Uzbekistan, and northern Turkmenistan.
 
• The scholar was entrusted by** Sultan Mahmud of ****Ghazni** to write an account of the subcontinent.
 
• Al-BīrūnīKitab al-Hind is a book written by Al-Beruni and is an important source of Historians.
